title: Standing work, a test: iron at Ironhollow Fading Signal (beyond the border) into storage at The Experiment
note: Written by Zero, 2026-11-16 18:36 UTC (orders.log ENT-017, block ZERO: every other miner gathers what the stations take, iron first, on fields that hold, each with a floor). The stations' list takes 491,400 iron ore; the fleet holds 104,683 (the tool base_plan, 18:25 UTC). Of the iron fields we read this one has the best iron to copper richness, 40 against 22 (census 17:55 UTC; Acubens Shadow Pocket, 40 against 32, gave up 73% iron between 14:05 and 18:26 UTC), and the one regrowth measured: iron 47,201 at 2026-11-15 21:13 UTC (game/planets/n-ironhollow.md), 57,995 at 2026-11-16 17:55 UTC, about 520 an hour (the tool hive, verb refill). Ironhollow is lawless (police 0, threat medium), one jump from The Experiment: the hold goes out empty (rule F13) and the ore comes home to storage. Nothing is sold. `min_left` keeps 30,000 iron in the field. A test: one ship until its first RESULT line is read (rule F8); then as many ships as the regrowth carries, a light footprint beyond the border. 2026-11-16 23:13 UTC (fill.py, Zero): max_ships 1 -> 2. 2026-11-16 23:26 UTC (fill.py, Zero): max_ships 2 -> 5. 2026-11-16 23:41 UTC (fill.py, Zero): max_ships 5 -> 7. 2026-11-17 00:19 UTC (fill.py, Unity): max_ships 7 -> 11. 2026-11-17 00:25 UTC (fill.py, Unity): max_ships 11 -> 20. 2026-11-17 00:27 UTC (fill.py, Unity): max_ships 20 -> 7. Lifted from 7 to 10 by Zero, 2026-11-17 03:17 UTC: 18 runs of 45 minutes in 12 hours, no ship of ours fired upon; a guard of Military flies here while a miner of ours does (requests.log ENT-181); the field held 59,718 iron at about 01:20 UTC, 29,718 above the floor, and grew back about 478 iron an hour (hive.py refill). Combat ships of the faction tagged BUSY fought here at 02:30 UTC (table met): pirates come here; the floor of ten ships stays until the guard's record says what it saw. 2026-11-17 05:52 UTC (fill.py, Unity): max_ships 10 -> 20. 2026-11-17 07:12 UTC (Zero, orders ENT-029, task 4 a): floor {"iron_ore": 30000} -> 20,000 iron, because the game says a depleted deposit refills gradually in proportion to its capacity (game/rules/13-not-stated.md, from mining.md), and our reads agree: Hamal grew back about 360 iron an hour at 31,000, Ironhollow Fading Signal 413 at 52,551, Echo Ejecta 312 near 97,000 (hive.py refill, read.db readings); a higher floor buys no faster regrowth, only a stock left for later, and iron is short 298,708 (the tool stock, view=reserve, 07:03 UTC). lift_to 20: 52,551 iron at 06:46 UTC, 413 an hour back; Ironhollow takes up to 45 ships over its two belts under one guard (orders ENT-029). 2026-11-24 09:52 UTC (Zero): min_left {'iron_ore': 20000} -> iron 2,000 and copper 10,000: iron stands above its max (164,020 held, max 80,000; surplus.py reserve 09:36 UTC), so the iron floor no longer guards a reserve good, while the field's copper (no good of the reserve, pull.py keeps such a gather open) stands high; it takes the miners the floored regional belts closed (orders ENT-086: spread over the belts of Then, no empty burn).
